title: Producer Inflation Jumps to 5.4%, Fuels Fed Hike Bets (UPDATED)
summary: U.S. producer prices rose 5.4% year-over-year in August, versus the 5.3% rate economists expected and accelerating from July’s 4.8% reading, according to Labor Department data released Thursday.
